ch02.goal.slope: The slope of $x(t)$ is the instantaneous velocity $v$; the slope of $v(t)$ is the acceleration $a$
ch02.goal.area: The area under $a(t)$ is the change in velocity $\Delta v$; the area under $v(t)$ is the displacement $\Delta x$
ch02.obs.slope: Slope mode: compare the slope of the tangent to $x(t)$ with the height of the dot on $v(t)$
ch02.obs.area: Area mode: area where $v < 0$ is negative (hatched), so $x$ decreases
ch02.obs.turn: Turnaround: when $v = 0$ the tangent to $x(t)$ is horizontal and the object reverses
ch02.obs.custom: Custom: drag the bars on the $a(t)$ graph up or down to set each segment's acceleration
ch02.assume: Acceleration is constant within each segment
